data.body:
[P2] Roll back the coordinator-owned attempt before dispatch

`ScenarioContext.attempts` returns a deep copy, so this `pop()` cannot remove the registered attempt. If saving `SUBMITTED` fails after `record_attempt()` succeeds, Invoke never runs, but the coordinator retains an unidentified launch. That phantom attempt prevents controls-only retirement and keeps the persistent fence. Add a coordinator-supported rollback that reconciles the persisted audit state, and test failure of the `SUBMITTED` save after successful registration; the existing audit-failure test fails earlier.
